title: 5412 Committee, Howard Hughes and the S-force turned against JFK

tellings.quote: And the narrative I've heard is that JFK, you know, uh, fires Dulles. Dulles is sort of licking his wounds and really angry at JFK and the Brown Brothers Haramman and reoperationalizes this S force to then take out uh uh JFK

plain: The story goes that after President John F. Kennedy fired Allen Dulles, the head of the CIA, an angry Dulles and the Wall Street bank Brown Brothers Harriman brought back a covert team called the S force to "take out" Kennedy. The story ties this team to the 5412 Committee, a secret White House group that approved covert operations in the 1950s, and to Richard Nixon and the billionaire Howard Hughes. Michels tells it himself as "the narrative I've heard", without naming a source, in an episode with a historian of the CIA.
